body: Wankhede nets, pehla rotation — Mahela ki ek line: "Kid, next net. Jasprit, one over." Teen balls, teen baar beat. Poora room dekh raha hai.

reader.text: Wankhede nets. Pehla serious rotation. Tum pads baandh rahe ho. Mahela, bina nazar uthaye: "Kid — next net. Jasprit, one over."
Bas itna. Bumrah ball ghumata hai. Na sledging, na smile. Room ka har free aadmi bahane se net ke paas khisak aaya hai.
Raat ko emotional post, subah seedha Bumrah. Scheduling department ka sense of humour savage hai 😄
Pehli ball — length kuch dikhti hai, guzarti kuch aur. Beat. Doosri — edge, side-net. Teesri — slower one: shot pehle khatam, ball baad mein aati hai.
Tum length guess kar rahe ho. Wrist pehle pick karo.
Hardik arms folded. Rohit bilkul still. Tilak apni baari bhool chuka hai. Teen balls bachi hain.
Teen balls ne expose kar diya. Agli teen decide karengi — student ya show-off. Kya karte ho?

reader.text: Team hotel, raat 9:30. Whiteboard pe XI nahi — sirf matchups: left-arm spin, death overs, powerplay, impact sub. Yahan naam baad mein aate hain, kaam pehle.
Meeting khatam. Sab nikal rahe hain. Hardik ka ishara: ruk. Mahela table pe, sheet saamne. Yeh casual nahi hai.

Pehla chance opening nahi hoga. No.5, shayad No.6. Shayad sirf 28 off 15 — na fifty, na highlight. Tu ready hai?

body: Eliminator. Chase 168 — 11th over mein wicket girta hai aur dugout ka ishara tumhara hai. Do over baad board simple: 52 chahiye, 30 gendein. Aur stand mein selectors baithe hain.

reader.text: Eliminator. Wankhede full — 33,000 log, sab khade. Chase 168. MI 89/4, 11th over mein wicket. Dugout ka ishara: tumhara.
Do hafte bench. Ek whiteboard ka number. Ab yeh walk. Recall 22 gaz pe hota hai. Crowd ko yaad hai tum kaun ho.
Hardik ne toss pe camera ke saamne bola tha: "Kid khelega. Mera call." Uska word ab tumhare bat mein hai.
Do over dekhte ho, singles kheenchte ho. Phir board simple: 52 chahiye, 30 gendein. Unka wide-yorker specialist do over bachaye baitha hai.
(rope se, drinks leke bhaagte hue) WIDE YORKER! Pehli teen! Ruk ke khel — deep point khula hai!
Rohit ne bola tha — "dono chalega, par decide kar." Tumne apna tareeka chuna. Aaj woh 33,000 ke saamne exam dega.
Scoreboard mat dekh. Meri aankh dekh. Hum yahan se jeet rahe hain — sawaal sirf ek hai: kaise.
52 off 30. Poora season, 30 gendein. Selectors stand mein. India ki list teen din mein. Kaise khelte ho?

Captain. Role clarity before ego.
He decides if your confidence is useful to the team or only to your image.

Freedom. But earned, not random.

The hardest mirror in the room.

"Hype sabko milta hai. Trust repeat performances se."
